meaning:
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.4;
son of: Ezer (H5829)
§ Hushah = "haste"
a descendant of Judah

elsewhere.note: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
